build_BYOL_model: build a BYOL self-supervised learning model with a backbone, projector, and predictor network
run_BYOL_forward: run the BYOL forward pass on two augmented views x1 and x2 to compute contrastive loss
test_sim_loss: test the BYOL similarity loss function by computing negative mean dot product of two tensors
refactor_momentum_update: refactor the BYOL momentum backbone update to adjust the momentum coefficient mmt for annealing
review_forward_backbone: review the BYOL forward backbone method that projects input through backbone and predictor then normalizes
